description.value:
Cost: 500eb

A photography AI that automatically optimizes your device's camera settings to achieve your photography goals. It is the only app on the market that doesn't use AI to artifically enhance images.

Adds +2 to Photography/Film for pictures or video . By standing still for 1 minute (20 rounds) or keeping the Agent's camera stationary for 1 minute you gain the benefits of the Image Enhance cybereye option, which immediately ends when you move or use the Evasion skill.

Foundry notes:

  • An app runs on a Neuroport or an Agent and does nothing without one (see the House Rules journal). Keep it in the inventory while the character has either.
  • The +2 to Photography/Film applies automatically. Image Enhance while still is not automated.

From Bontari Homebrew Cyberpunk Items by Bontari (Apps).
